display.purpose: The screen's own name. One per screen, always the h1, never inside a component.

headline.purpose: Money, XP, prices, counts. The figures a student came for.

body.purpose: Prose, list rows, UI text. The workhorse at 15px.

label.purpose: Caps labels, stamps, stock counts, metadata. tabular-nums on anything that counts.

annotation.purpose: The margin voice. One short phrase per view, tilted, never load-bearing.

shadows.name: paper
shadows.purpose: One sheet resting on another. Cards, badges, buttons, ticket stubs.

shadows.name: paper-lg
shadows.purpose: The hover state, and the only thing hover changes.

shadows.name: paper-inset
shadows.purpose: A sheet pressed into the surface.

shadows.name: hand
shadows.purpose: The violet variant, for objects sitting on a violet ground.

shadows.name: sticker-cut
shadows.purpose: Not a shadow: the white keyline of a die-cut sticker. Always composed before a paper shadow.

motion.name: dur-med
motion.purpose: Shadow lift, the tab blob, dialog entrance.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: The longest thing the system allows.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one route forward on a screen. Die-cut keyline over a flat paper shadow.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White fill with a pencil ring standing in for a border.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: No box. A bottom pencil line and wobbly top corners; focus sweeps a butter highlighter across the bottom of the field. The system's signature interaction.

components.name: Card
components.description: Wobbly corners, flat paper shadow. Hover lifts the shadow and washes the surface 5% toward ink; nothing moves.

components.name: Badge
components.description: A die-cut sticker. Pill, tinted, with a keyline and a flat shadow.

components.name: Bottom Tab Bar
components.description: A floating white pill. The current tab grows a hand-drawn blob in its own tint behind the icon. Labels are visually hidden; blob plus icon carry the state.

components.description: An event ticket. Two radial gradients punch a notch through both edges at the tear line, intersected so only what both masks agree is opaque survives.

narrative.overview:
A cork board outside a lecture hall, three weeks into term. Flyers overlap at slight angles because someone pinned them in a hurry. A drop is announced on a card that is literally a card. Someone has circled a number in marker. Nothing on the board is generated; every piece was made by a person and put there by a person.

This is a phone-first H5 for students between classes, so the board is dense and everything on it is legible in one pass, but density never becomes uniformity: a mission tile, a quest card, a folder and a ticket stub are four different objects and they look like four different objects. Colour is carried by the paper, not by the wall.

The system rejects three specific things, named by the owner: a job board, a creator-commerce feed, and an enterprise SaaS admin. The third is the easiest to drift into when building app screens rather than marketing pages. Gamification is deliberately not rejected.
keyCharacteristics: Hand-drawn geometry: wobbly radii, flat offset shadows, marker circles, tally strokes
Colour lives on paper objects, never on page backgrounds or navigation chrome
Five type families, each with one job, and a five-rung size ladder
Nothing in the system blurs and nothing moves on hover
Every control clears a 44px touch target, whatever the drawn ink measures

rules.name: The Paper Objects Rule
rules.body: Accents belong to things you could pick up: folders, bubbles, notes, stickers, cards. They are never a page background and never navigation chrome. The wall stays white.

rules.name: The Navigation Stays Core Rule
rules.body: Tabs, segmented switches and nav chrome use violet, white and ink only. The bottom tab bar is the exception: each of its four fixed destinations carries its own soft accent behind the active icon, so a glance at the colour says where you are before the icon is read. Four destinations that never reorder can be learned as colours; a variable nav cannot.

rules.name: The Measured Band Rule
rules.body: Text on a coloured band is measured, never assumed. Four of the five bands in this app failed AA as first drawn, and coral with white text was 2.82:1.

rules.name: The Five Rungs Rule
rules.body: Every font size names a rung: 10 / 12 / 15 / 18 / 22px. No stylesheet writes a number. Picking a size by eye is what produced 130 hardcoded values across 25 sizes down to 9px before the ladder existed.

rules.name: The One Note Rule
rules.body: Lacquer is one short phrase per view, tilted off the baseline, never a sentence, and never anything the screen cannot be read without. If it carries information, it is a lede in body type, not a note.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Sentence case everywhere, headlines and buttons included. The only uppercase is the DynaPuff screen title and the Gabarito caps label, both stamps rather than sentences.

rules.name: The Ground Casts No Shadow Rule
rules.body: A full-bleed panel is the ground the screen stands on, and ground does not cast a shadow. Only things resting on that ground cast.

rules.name: The Nothing Moves Rule
rules.body: Hover raises the shadow and may wash the surface. It never translates, never tilts, never scales. Tilt is a resting property: cards and folders are drawn at ±1-4° and stay there.

dos: Do name a rung for every font size: 10 / 12 / 15 / 18 / 22px. Never write a number into a stylesheet.
Do give every control a 44px target even when the drawn ink is smaller. The target is sized, not the ink.
Do measure contrast on any new coloured band before shipping it.
Do keep tilt as a resting property. Cards and folders are drawn at ±1-4° and stay there.
Do let a full-bleed panel run off the bottom of the screen. It is the ground; it reaches the floor.
Do change components in axelerate-design-system and reach the app by bumping the pinned SHA.
donts: Don't build a job board. No rows of near-identical listings, no filter rail that outweighs the content.
Don't build a creator-commerce feed. No cover images wall-to-wall, no follower counts as the headline.
Don't build an enterprise SaaS admin. No grey sidebar, no data tables, no dashboard cards, no navy.
Don't move anything on hover. No translate, no tilt, no scale. The shadow lifts and that is all.
Don't blur. If a shadow has a blur radius, it is not from this system.
Don't put an accent on a page background or on navigation chrome.
Don't put white text on coral (2.82:1) or any other band colour you have not measured.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a coloured stripe.
Don't let Lacquer carry information. If the screen cannot be read without it, it is not a note.
Don't hold gamification back. XP, levels, streaks and quests are wanted.
